title: Run the frozen H115 Frobenius--Kummer moment falsification panel
status_note: Producer, Lean proof layer and independent verifier are published before data; the managed runtime has no checkpoint upload transport or digest-pinned EKS task image.

question: Does one unchanged predicate in the frozen 648-member H115 family give an exact scalar digit modulo six on all 15 rows and decode all 366 toy-curve targets?
decision_value: A nonempty independently verified 15-row exact-ID intersection advances the candidate to larger out-of-sample cohorts and a uniform moment-computation proof obligation; an empty intersection rejects this frozen low-order resolvent-moment family.

resources.notes: The frozen execution deadline is 1,800 seconds and budget is USD 1.00. Integer-hour estimates round that ceiling upward; they are planning limits, not observed runtime. Zero scientific retries are allowed.

env.name: crypto-h115-frobenius-kummer
env.recipe: Build a UID-1000-compatible digest-pinned Isolab image from crypto producer source revision 6d8def5473 and retain cryptanalysis verifier revision ed206d8d for independent output verification.

cairn.notes: Single exhaustive frozen run; not preemptible because the producer has no mid-run checkpoint. Do not replace it with a local scoring run. Promotion to ready must copy/freeze the existing protocol in this card, pin merged source commits and bind the runnable independent verifier.

funding.rationale: Lower seed-card level: one bounded toy-cohort falsification with complete producer and verifier source, but no generic-speedup claim.
